# Decision records

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the records in this directory. Do not edit. -->

Each record explains one architectural decision. Accepted records are never edited except for the Status line. See [0001](0001-record-architecture-decisions.md).

A record has one of these statuses:

- `Accepted`: the decision is in force.
- `Superseded by NNNN`: a newer record replaced the decision. NNNN is that record's number.
